items.html:
No concrete source/wheel/artifact identity defect found in the inspected integration tree.

  • Candidate source is fixed to the dispatch SHA and requires successful main push CI for that exact commit.
  • Wheel/sdist jobs checkout that SHA; assembly validates the complete wheel family, package versions, required contents, and checksums.
  • TestPyPI and PyPI receive the same assembled run artifacts. Promotion requires an annotated tag targeting the qualified SHA; GitHub publication checks it again.
  • Documentation now explicitly uploads and deploys the complete Pages artifact.

Residual gates: hosted wheel builds, trusted publishers/environment protections, immutable tag rules, Pages deployment, and clean TestPyPI/PyPI installation remain unverified.

Read-only inspection only; no tests, builds, edits, network calls, or GitHub changes.
